Notes: Polish Wikipedia quoting Slownik Geograficzny: settlement had a synagogue and 899 inhabitants including 650 Jews; year taken as ~1889 (other sources say 1888); Jewish cemetery also listed
1921 census: 666 Jews, 80% of the village population
Ghetto established 1 June 1940 holding about 2000 Jews from Siedliszcze Krakow Lublin and Czechoslovakia combined; mixed deportee count so Population blank
On 18 May 1942 about 630 Jews sent to Sobibor; ghetto liquidated October 1942 with remaining inmates sent to Sobibor (deportation counts include non-residents)
